programmes.d: Infamous outlaw Augustine Chacon murders two Texas Rangers, prompting Matt and Margaret to travel south of the border to bring him to justice.
Matt and Margaret follow the trail of Cherokee Bill after he kills a marshal riding a train, and they find the outlaw hiding out in his mother's cabin.
Cattle rustling leads to the cancellation of a contract to supply beef for railroad construction crews, and Matt Clark is called in to stop it.
Two criminals vow to fight the railroad when their homestead is threatened.
Hollister captures a wounded bank robber in the desert after he kills both of their horses.
Hollister uses a specially equipped stagecoach to trap Manitou after he attacks innocents.
Lucas gives a once-famous marshal a chance for rehabilitation.
Lucas has in-law trouble when his late wife's brother arrives in town.
Mark is kidnapped by a man who blames Lucas for his own son's death.
An Italian count arrives in North Fork and challenges the town bully to a duel.
Bat ejects a business partner from a casino after he catches the man embezzling money, but instead of deterring the crook, Bat only provokes his ire.
Bat comes to a friend for employment, but when murder strikes, he must take over his late friend's job of escorting three mail-order brides to their designated husbands.
Yancy spends the holiday season searching for the murderer of his uncle Henry Spinner.
Romilly Vale ruins Yancy's plans for a quiet evening gambling at Madame Francine's.
A mysterious stranger disrupts three people's lives as well as his own.
Circumstantial evidence condemns a man to death by hanging.
A wife begs Josh to find her husband.
Josh's prisoners steal a man's horses.
A gun-fighting stranger comes to the small settlement of Lago and is hired to bring the townsfolk together in an attempt to hold off three outlaws who are on their way.
A cunning Profane Sister Sara recruits a drifter to help Mexican rebels launch a surprise attack on a French fort.
A land baron's (Robert Duvall) gunman (Clint Eastwood) joins a rebel (John Saxon) fighting for Spanish land grants in 1900 New Mexico.
A coward launches a personal search for courage.
A doctor takes a beating rather than give away a patient's identity.
An Easterner pursues the man who killed his brother.
A rattlesnake draws an outlaw and his pursuer together.
An unpopular lawman faces a town's ire when he arrests a well-loved outlaw.
A washed-up gunman drinks and recalls past glories.
A man tries to get back the land he feels was cheated from him.
The owners of a traveling tent show are forced into helping a gang of bank robbers.
A con man resorts to murder in a phony land promotion scheme.
Sabotage delays a civil engineer's (Randolph Scott) completion of a railroad for shipping gold safely in Nevada.
A Confederate (Randolph Scott) and his men rob Union gold in Nevada, then learn the war's been over for a month.
